lines.en: label pornshop20:
scene makotomakidildo1
I arrive at the porn shop to find a less-than-happy Makoto standing still at the counter and already hating the fact that I am, yet again, visiting her at work.
lines.zh: 我到了色情用品店，看到 Makoto 一脸不悦地站在柜台后面，已经对我又一次在她上班时跑来找她这件事感到厌烦了。

lines.en: You’d think that after taking her virginity she’d be a lot more accepting of my degenerate side, but I guess she’s still just normal, old Makoto after all.
lines.zh: 你大概会以为，夺走她的处女之身后，她对我堕落那一面的接受度会高很多，可我想她终究还是那个普通的老样子 Makoto。

lines.en: : Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat? Why are you here?
lines.zh: : 什————————么？你来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : Let me sell porn in peace.
lines.zh: : 让我安安静静地卖片行不行。

lines.en: : I can’t get enough of you, Makoto. Staying away is impossible.
lines.zh: : 我对你怎么也看不够，Makoto。想离你远点是不可能的。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo2
: As if I’d believe that from the same guy who routinely calls girls into his office to do God-knows-what to them.
lines.zh: : 这话从一个动不动就把女孩叫进办公室、对她们干些天知道什么的事的家伙嘴里说出来，我怎么可能信。

lines.en: : It’s called counseling. And that sour attitude of yours makes me think it might be time for you to receive some.
lines.zh: : 那叫心理辅导。而你那副酸溜溜的态度让我觉得，也许该轮到你接受一点辅导了。

lines.en: : Right, right. I’m sure that would be a great conversation with Mother.
lines.zh: : 是是是。我敢肯定，跟妈妈聊这个一定很精彩。

lines.en: : Hey, Mom? I need counseling now.
lines.zh: : 嘿，妈？我现在需要心理辅导。

lines.en: : {i}Why, dear? What’s wrong?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么了，亲爱的？出什么事了？{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not excited enough about selling anal gangbang videos to my teacher. I must be rehabilitated.
lines.zh: : 我对把肛交群交片卖给我的老师这件事不够兴奋。我得接受改造。

lines.en: : To be fair, your mother always seems very excited about the concept of anal gangbang videos.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你妈妈对肛交群交片这个概念似乎一直都很兴奋。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo3
: My mom is a fucking creep! She doesn’t count!
lines.zh: : 我妈就是个该死的变态！她不算数！

lines.en: : I can hear you, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 我听得见哦，Makoto！

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo4
: Shut up, Mom!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，妈！

lines.en: : I love you, sweetie!
lines.zh: : 我爱你，宝贝！

lines.en: : You two are so cute together.
lines.zh: : 你们两个在一起真般配。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo5
: You are the bane of my existence.
lines.zh: : 你是我生命里的灾星。

lines.en: : Wow. And to think you’d say something like that after all of the precious memories we made during the Halloween party.
lines.zh: : 哇。想想我们在万圣节派对上留下了那么多珍贵的回忆，你居然还能说出这种话。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo6
: Those memories were made with fun-Makoto. Business-Makoto is currently in charge, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 那些回忆是和「玩乐模式」的 Makoto 一起创造的。现在掌权的是「营业模式」的 Makoto，多谢关心。

lines.en: : And also, please don’t speak any further about the memories we made while my mother is right around the corner re-stocking vibrators.
lines.zh: : 还有，我妈就在拐角处补货震动棒呢，请别再往下细说我们制造过的回忆了。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised you sell enough of those to warrant re-stocking them.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很惊讶你们那玩意儿居然卖得动，还得补货。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo7
: Well, you know. It’s getting close to Christmas and the historic lack of men means a lot of women buying presents for one another.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，你也知道。快到圣诞节了，而长期缺少男人，就意味着很多女人会互相买礼物。

lines.en: : Right. And what better present than the gift of an orgasm?
lines.zh: : 对。还有什么礼物比一次高潮更好？

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 对哦……

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo8
: Wait! Not right! There are a lot of better presents out there!
lines.zh: : 等等！不对！比这好的礼物多了去了！

lines.en: : Like...golf clubs! Or a trip to the zoo!
lines.zh: : 比如说……高尔夫球杆！或者去动物园玩一趟！

lines.en: : Or this.
lines.zh: : 或者这个。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo9
I reach behind me and manage to grab hold of a display-dildo sitting on top of a shelf, placing it directly into Makoto’s hand.
lines.zh: 我伸手往身后一够，抓到了架子顶上一个展示用的假阳具，直接塞进 Makoto 手里。

lines.en: She angrily looks over it, likely pondering the kindest way to remove me from the store without her mother getting mad at her for turning away a real-live customer.
lines.zh: 她气鼓鼓地端详着它，大概在琢磨怎么才能最温和地把我赶出店去，又不至于让她妈因为赶走一个活生生的客人而生气。

lines.en: : One Christmas present, please.
lines.zh: : 一份圣诞礼物，谢谢。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo10
: Would you like it gift-wrapped, sir?
lines.zh: : 需要礼品包装吗，先生？

lines.en: jump makotomakidildox
label makotomakidildox:
: No thank you. I’m going to walk down the street waving it around and proclaiming my love for the girl it’s for.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。我要拿着它上街挥舞，向它要送给的那个女孩宣告我的爱。

lines.en: : And who may I ask is this for, sir?
lines.zh: : 请问这是送给谁的呢，先生？

lines.en: : Yumi Yamaguchi. Class 1-A.
lines.zh: : Yumi Yamaguchi。1-A 班。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo11
: I know what fucking class she’s in! It’s mine!
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然知道她是哪个班的！就是我们班！

lines.en: : And like hell I’d believe you’d buy something like this for {i}her{/i} of all people!
lines.zh: : 而且我死也不信你会买这种东西送给{i}她{/i}——送谁不好偏偏是她！

lines.en: : You’re right. It’s actually for you.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。其实是送给你的。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo12
: How is that any better?!
lines.zh: : 那又有什么好的？！

lines.en: : This is the last thing I want for Christmas!
lines.zh: : 这是我圣诞节最不想要的东西！

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo13
: Aww, nuts. Did Sensei steal my Christmas present idea?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，糟糕。Sensei 偷走了我的圣诞礼物点子？

lines.en: : I had one wrapped up and everything.
lines.zh: : 我都包装好了，什么都准备好了。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo14
: What kind of horrible mother would buy something like this for her daughter? Just what kind of monster do you think I am?
lines.zh: : 什么样的可怕母亲会给自己女儿买这种东西？你到底把我想成什么怪物了？

lines.en: : Are you upset because you don’t know how to use it? I know it might look intimidating, but with a little bit of effort-
lines.zh: : 你是不是因为不会用才生气？我知道它看着可能有点吓人，不过只要稍微努力一下——

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo15
: What do you want, Mom?
lines.zh: : 你想要什么，妈？

lines.en: : All I want is for my daughter to be happy. And if that means teaching her how to use-
lines.zh: : 我只想要我女儿幸福。如果那意味着教她怎么使用——

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo16
: Here! You have it if you like it so much!
lines.zh: : 给你！你这么喜欢就归你了！

lines.en: : Go get me a normal present like a...phone charm! Or a book!
lines.zh: : 去给我买件正常的礼物，比如……手机挂件！或者一本书！

lines.en: : But dear, I already have this one. And while the idea of two of them isn’t {i}entirely{/i} out of the question, I don’t think-
lines.zh: : 可是亲爱的，我已经有这个了。虽然来两个也不是{i}完全{/i}不行，但我觉得——

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo17
: Do you see what you’ve done?
lines.zh: : 你看看你干的好事？

lines.en: : Oh my. I forgot you were there for a moment. How do you do, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我都忘了你还在旁边呢。你好吗，老师？

lines.en: : I’m fine. My pants seem to keep getting tighter, though.
lines.zh: : 我很好。不过我的裤子好像越来越紧了。

lines.en: : Do you need any help adjusting them? I have a sewing machine upstairs and we can-
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙改一改吗？我楼上有台缝纫机，我们可以——

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo18
: MOM!
: Oh dear. It seems I’ve made my daughter quite angry.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。看来我把女儿惹得很生气。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo19
: Oh! I know! How about the two of you take a little time off and go for a walk in the park?
lines.zh: : 哦！我知道了！要不你们两个休息一会儿，去公园散个步？

lines.en: : Wait, seriously? I can take the night off?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？我今晚可以休息？

lines.en: : Are you going to be okay here by yourself?
lines.zh: : 你一个人在这里没问题吗？

lines.en: : Also, as my mother, shouldn’t you be preventing me from walking around in the dark with a man who just openly admitted to having an erection?
lines.zh: : 还有，作为我妈，你不是该阻止我在天黑后、和一个刚刚公然承认自己勃起了的男人出去逛吗？

lines.en: : Hey, all I said was that my pants were getting tighter. Get your mind out of the gutter, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 喂，我只说我的裤子变紧了。别想歪了，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo20
: I’m not worried. You’re a responsible girl and won’t let anything bad happen. I know you can hold your own out there if he tries anything.
lines.zh: : 我不担心。你是个有分寸的女孩，不会让坏事发生。我知道就算他动手动脚，你也能应付。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo21
: Oh...Umm, yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦……嗯，是啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can hold my own. I’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我能应付。我不会有事的。

lines.en: : Besides, I think you might be a liiiiiittle too [young]for Sensei, dear~
lines.zh: : 再说，我觉得你对 Sensei 来说可能[young]了那么一丁点，亲爱的～

lines.en: I’m not even going to get involved in this part of the discussion.
lines.zh: 这段对话我可一点都不打算掺和。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo22
: {i}Mom.{/i}
: Yes, dear?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，亲爱的？

lines.en: : Take this stupid dildo out of my hands so I can go for a walk with my teacher.
lines.zh: : 把我手里这根破假阳具拿走，好让我跟老师去散步。

lines.en: : Yes, dear~
lines.zh: : 好的，亲爱的～

lines.en: scene black
Looks like I didn’t even need to worry about getting involved since the conversation resolved on its own.
lines.zh: 看来我根本不用担心要掺和，这场对话自己就解决了。

lines.en: I guess there’s no one out there better at dealing with Maki than the girl who’s been answering to her nonsense for the last...however many years Makoto has been alive for.
lines.zh: 我想，要对付 Maki，没人比得过这个——在过去这 Makoto 活了多少年，就听了她多少年胡言乱语的女孩。

lines.en: The two of us exit the porn shop and make our way to the same park where we bumped into each other quite some time ago.
lines.zh: 我们俩走出色情用品店，走向那个我们很久以前曾偶然相遇的公园。

lines.en: scene nightsky
Makoto shivers and sneaks closer to me, thinking I don’t notice when, in all actuality, it’s pretty obvious.
lines.zh: Makoto 打了个哆嗦，悄悄往我身边靠，以为我没注意到——实际上明显得很。

lines.en: It’s a little funny how she can go from business-Makoto to fun and cute Makoto at the drop of a hat.
lines.zh: 她能在转瞬之间从「营业模式」的 Makoto 变成好玩又可爱的 Makoto，这还真有点好笑。

lines.en: But I guess being alone with the person you admire is an understandable trigger.
lines.zh: 不过，和自己仰慕的人独处，会是这种导火索也情有可原。

lines.en: Eventually, we wind up on a park bench drowned in the glow of a dying streetlight and bring up the one thing that’s likely been on both of our minds since I walked in tonight.
lines.zh: 最后，我们坐在一张被昏黄路灯光淹没的公园长椅上，聊起了自我今晚进门起大概就一直挂在我俩心头的那件事。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo23
: So, how does it feel not being a virgin anymore? Any different?
lines.zh: : 那么，不再是处女了是什么感觉？有什么不同吗？

lines.en: : Not as different as I thought it would feel. I’m happy we went through with it, though.
lines.zh: : 没有我想象中那么不同。不过我很高兴我们做了。

lines.en: : You mean how you basically blackmailed me into deflowering you while you were drunk?
lines.zh: : 你是说你趁喝醉，基本算是勒索我、逼我破了你的身？

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo24
: I did what I had to do, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我是做了该做的事，Sensei。

lines.en: : If I left it up to you, you’d have probably held off until I was in college. I don’t have that kind of time.
lines.zh: : 要是交给你决定，你大概会一直拖到我上大学。我可没那么多时间。

lines.en: : You definitely do have that kind of time, though.
lines.zh: : 可你明明有那么多时间啊。

lines.en: : Also, you’re giving me way more credit than I deserve. At best, I only had a month left in me before I pulled the plug anyway.
lines.zh: : 还有，你太高看我了。说到底，我最多也就再撑一个月就会自己拔掉保险栓了。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess you don’t have as much restraint as I thought you did, then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……看来你的自制力没有我想的那么强。

lines.en: : Obviously not, Wicked Witch.
lines.zh: : 显然不强，邪恶女巫。

lines.en: : I kept the costume. Want me to wear it again sometime?
lines.zh: : 那套服装我还留着。要我改天再穿一次吗？

lines.en: : Every day for the rest of your life, please.
lines.zh: : 你这辈子每天都穿，拜托了。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo25
: Uhh...No. That’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 呃……不行。那不可能。

lines.en: : Once a week?
lines.zh: : 一周一次？

lines.en: : Closer but that’s still a little excessive.
lines.zh: : 接近了，不过还是有点过分。

lines.en: : I’m glad to hear you liked it so much, though.
lines.zh: : 不过听你这么喜欢，我挺高兴的。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re cute {i}with{/i} glasses, but without them it’s like...a whole different type of monster.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你{i}戴{/i}眼镜的时候很可爱，可一摘掉就变成了……完全不同种类的怪物。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo26
: Unfortunately, that monster comes at the cost of not being able to see anything.
lines.zh: : 可惜，那只怪物的代价是什么都看不见。

lines.en: : You don’t have contacts?
lines.zh: : 你没有隐形眼镜吗？

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo27
: I do, but...I can’t put them in. My eyes get all watery every time I try and it’s a whole thing.
lines.zh: : 有啊，可是……我戴不进去。每次一试着戴，眼睛就止不住地流泪，总之特别麻烦。

lines.en: : So right now, I’m pretty blind to tell you the truth. I can barely make out your face.
lines.zh: : 所以说实话，我现在基本是个瞎子。你的脸我几乎看不清。

lines.en: : And at the Halloween party?
lines.zh: : 那万圣节派对那天呢？

lines.en: : Oh, I had them in for that. But Miku had to hold my arms down while my mom put them in for me. It sucked.
lines.zh: : 哦，那次戴着呢。可 Miku 得按住我的胳膊，让我妈给我戴进去。烦死了。

lines.en: : Well I’ll be damned. Makoto Miyamura has a weakness after all.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，没想到。Makoto Miyamura 原来也有弱点。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo28
: I have plenty of weaknesses. I just don’t want anyone to know about them.
lines.zh: : 我的弱点多了去了。我只是不想让任何人知道。

lines.en: : That’s not healthy.
lines.zh: : 那样可不健康。

lines.en: : No, it's really not.
lines.zh: : 是啊，真的很不健康。

lines.en: : It’s fine to talk, you know? My office is open at any time.
lines.zh: : 说出来也没关系的，你知道吧？我的办公室随时敞开。

lines.en: : You mean your massage parlor?
lines.zh: : 你是说你的按摩院？

lines.en: : Really depends on the client, to tell the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那得看客人是谁。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo29
: Don’t even worry about it, Sensei. None of my problems are that serious compared to some of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 这个你别操心了，Sensei。比起其他一些女孩，我的问题都算不上什么严重的事。

lines.en: : Miku’s like Pandora’s Box once you start reading into her. But that’s something you’ll have to hear from her instead of me.
lines.zh: : Miku 一旦你深入了解，就像个潘多拉魔盒。不过那事你得听她说，不该由我来讲。

lines.en: : Will I hear {i}anything{/i} from you?
lines.zh: : 那我能从你这儿听到{i}点什么{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Not just about Miku or the other girls, but yourself.
lines.zh: : 不只是关于 Miku 或其他女孩，而是关于你自己。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo30
: Hmm...
Makoto stays silent for a moment, looking deeply into my eyes and trying to figure out if she wants to talk or not.
lines.zh: Makoto 沉默了片刻，深深望进我的眼睛，试图判断自己想不想说。

lines.en: : Wanna hear about what happened after you left me on Halloween?
lines.zh: : 想听听万圣节那晚你离开我之后发生了什么吗？
: ……我该听吗？

lines.en: : I don’t like how you lead into that.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这个开场。

lines.en: : Why? Worried someone found me covered in Sensei-juice?
lines.zh: : 为什么？担心有人发现我浑身沾满了 Sensei 的汁液？

lines.en: : Very much, actually.
lines.zh: : 说实话，非常担心。

lines.en: : I thought about it on the way home, but I probably shouldn’t have just...left like that.
lines.zh: : 我在回家的路上想过了，但我大概不该就这么……丢下你走了。

lines.en: : Probably not. But you did and that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 大概是不该。不过你确实走了，那也没关系。

lines.en: : I wasn’t expecting you to spend the rest of the night with me, especially after I passed out.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没指望你陪我过完那一夜，尤其在我昏过去之后。

lines.en: : So...who found you, then?
lines.zh: : 那么……是谁发现了你？

lines.en: : You really wanna know?
lines.zh: : 你真想知道？

lines.en: : Just...tell me, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 就……告诉我吧，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo31
: It was..
My heart drops as she prepares to tell me how things ended up that night.
lines.zh: 她正要说出那晚的结局，我的心往下一沉。

lines.en: The best case scenario would be someone like Futaba who probably wouldn’t share something so...intense.
lines.zh: 最好的情况，是 Futaba 那样的人，她大概不会把这么……劲爆的事说出去。

lines.en: But the worst case scenario would probably be Ami or Ayane or-
lines.zh: 可最糟的情况，大概是 Ami 或者 Ayane，或者——

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : ...‘s butler.
lines.zh: : ……家的管家。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god.
lines.zh: : 我的个天哪。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo32
: Hehehe~ Had you going there, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿~ 骗到你了吧？

lines.en: : You’re evil.
lines.zh: : 你真邪恶。

lines.en: : Consider that payback for harassing me at work all the time.
lines.zh: : 这就当是你老在我上班时骚扰我的报应。

lines.en: : You think doing this is going to make me stop?
lines.zh: : 你以为这样我就会收手？

lines.en: : Probably not, but it's worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 大概不会，不过值得一试。

lines.en: : What did Geoffrey say? I thought he was supposed to be sick in bed or something.
lines.zh: : Geoffrey 说了什么？他不是应该卧病在床之类的吗？

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo33
: That’s the weird part. He didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 怪就怪在这儿。他什么都没说。

lines.en: : He just stood in the doorway and turned around while I straightened myself out.
lines.zh: : 他就站在门口，然后转身背过去，等我整理好衣服。

lines.en: : I don’t even think he saw anything, to be honest. He probably just thought I was passed out from drinking too much.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得他什么都没看见。他大概只当我是喝多了昏过去了。

lines.en: : It’s not like I was still exposed or anything. And the way I limped out of there could have probably just been chalked up to, again, alcohol.
lines.zh: : 反正我又没有还露着什么。而我那一瘸一拐地走出去，大概也还是可以归结为——又是酒精的缘故。

lines.en: : This might just be the single most convenient thing that has ever happened to me.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我这辈子遇过的最走运的一件事了。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo32
: Probably. God only knows what would have happened if someone closer to you found me in that state.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。天知道要是跟你更亲近的人撞见我那副样子会怎样。

lines.en: : Knowing we disappeared together would have probably led to all sorts of rumors, huh?
lines.zh: : 知道我们一起消失，大概会引来各种流言吧？

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 对哦……

lines.en: Something about the way she says that makes me uneasy.
lines.zh: 她说这话的某种语气让我不安。

lines.en: It’s a confusing tone I haven’t ever heard from Makoto before- almost like she {i}wanted{/i} something like that to happen.
lines.zh: 那是种我从没在 Makoto 身上听到过的、令人费解的语气——几乎像是她{i}希望{/i}那种事发生。

lines.en: She wouldn’t do that, would she?
lines.zh: 她不会那么做的，对吧？

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo34
: Umm...I didn’t get to really say it back then, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯……那时候我没能好好说出来，不过——

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : For finally having sex with me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你终于和我做了。

lines.en: : I really, {i}really{/i} needed to get that out of my system. And there’s no one else I would have rather done it with other than you.
lines.zh: : 我真的、{i}真的{/i}需要把它发泄出来。而除了你，我不想跟任何人做这件事。

lines.en: : Or maybe Ryan Gosling.
lines.zh: : 或者 Ryan Gosling。

lines.en: : Actually, definitely Ryan Gosling.
lines.zh: : 说真的，绝对是 Ryan Gosling。

lines.en: : But you were a close second.
lines.zh: : 不过你算是紧随其后的第二名。

lines.en: : Who is this Ryan guy and where can I find him?
lines.zh: : 这个 Ryan 是谁，我去哪儿能找到他？

lines.en: : Hollywood, probably. Wanna catch a flight there when the borders open back up?
lines.zh: : 大概在好莱坞吧。等边境重开，要不要搭飞机过去？

lines.en: : I’ll be going alone. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我会一个人去的。谢了。

lines.en: : Fighting to defend my honor?
lines.zh: : 这是要为我捍卫名誉？

lines.en: : Fighting to defend my witch.
lines.zh: : 是为捍卫我的女巫而战。

lines.en: scene makotomakidildo35
: Aaaand we're back at the witch costume, huh?...
lines.zh: : 然——后又绕回女巫装了，是吧？……

lines.en: : You really like that thing, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢那套衣服，对吧？

lines.en: : You have no idea, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你根本想象不到，Makoto。

lines.en: : You have no idea.
lines.zh: : 你根本想象不到。

lines.en: scene black
We leave the park shortly after that and, get this, {i}hold hands{/i} for a block or two.
lines.zh: 之后没多久我们就离开了公园，而且——猜怎么着——我们{i}手牵手{/i}走了一两个街区。

lines.en: Obviously, Makoto is the one who initiates it. But feeling bad about the aftermath of what transpired on Halloween, I let it happen.
lines.zh: 显然，是 Makoto 先牵的。不过想到万圣节那件事的后续，我有些过意不去，就由着她了。

lines.en: It feels good making her happy every once in a while.
lines.zh: 偶尔让她开心一下，感觉也不错。

lines.en: I can just never tell if the happiness is superficial or not.
lines.zh: 我只是永远分不清那份快乐是不是浮于表面。

lines.en: She’s...surprisingly confusing at times.
lines.zh: 她……有时候意外地让人摸不透。

lines.en: But I guess that’s just what you get when you wind up sleeping with someone smarter than you.
lines.zh: 不过，跟一个比你聪明的人睡到一起，大概就是这样。
